summary: PS International Group Ltd., a Hong Kong–based freight forwarding and cargo firm listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K reporting its interim results for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The exhibit is a routine half-year financial report with segment revenue tables and equity-incentive-plan disclosures; no transaction, stakeholder action, or corporate event is described. Disclosure includes revenue by shipment type and service line and activity under the 2024 Share Incentive Plan. No price, stake, board recommendation, or advisor is stated. This is an ordinary periodic-reporting filing (the non-US equivalent of a domestic 10-Q), not a special situation; no deal terms are present and no risk-arb angle applies.
